features.note: The opaque architecture views preserve the front threshold, long center spine, paired room masses and rear separation; the engineering views expose the same plan without losing circulation boundaries.
Burgundy seating masses, charcoal structure and matte purple carpet remain separated, and the stepped auditorium reading survives both close and engineering views.
The facade, entrance bank and public-floor zone remain a coherent front-of-house threshold; red, warm-white, charcoal, glass and public tile form a clear commercial hierarchy.
Green solid RS-485 and blue dashed/solid network media stay unambiguous against the translucent shell, while endpoint and bus labels remain readable in the engineering captures.
The architecture state is opaque and materially grounded; the engineering state is distinctly translucent and preserves zones, labels and media without changing the accepted building massing.

important_features.note: Facade people, door heights and the one-unit-equals-one-meter overlay retain a credible building scale; engineering labels identify small endpoints without enlarging them into architectural masses.
The current look-dev light is sufficient to separate bright public finishes from the darker carpeted auditorium/corridor materials; final lighting polish is not required at this pass.
The engineering set keeps the green bus runs, blue media and endpoint groups visually contained and traceable through the translucent shell.

defects: Concrete and coated warm-white separate clearly by value and sheen, but their micro-response remains subtle in the widest neutral and facade captures.
The public-tile versus carpet contrast is strongest in the dedicated floor view; the tile reflection remains restrained rather than mirror-like.

mechanical.note: All nine current capture sidecars report console_clean with no issues. Probe medians are 164 draws and 22344 triangles against budgets of 550 and 750000; fps is informational only under SwiftShader.
